note: Bridger-Teton NF campground under tall pines on one large loop beside the Greys River valley, about 35 mi (roughly an hour) from Alpine on gravel Greys River Rd (FS 10138), then FS 10037. Nearby forest roads suit side-by-sides. --Claude
summary: FS page: 13 sites on one loop, FCFS (no rec.gov listing), 14-day limit, trailers to 30 ft, 2 vehicles/site, vault toilets, one hand pump whose water may not be potable (FS amenity line: 'Potable water is not available'), $10 / $18 in season, opens May 1 (free after closure with amenities off). Not waterfront confirmed (Greys River ~450 m W).
